**Order 1** (first-order): \n46\t     - `packed[0]` is seed ival1\n47\t     - `packed[i]` (i>0) are differences with minsd subtracted\n48\t     - Reconstruction: `prev += packed[i] + minsd`\n49\t   - The only difference is the extra octets (seed values) and the spatial differencing reconstruction pass.\n68\t\n69\t## Exact Failure Location (Pre-Fix)\n70\t\n71\t**Symptom**: `Error::TooShort { needed: 262792, got: 0 }`  \n72\t**Location**: `decode_section7` → `decode_drt3` → line 1221 (packed values length check)  \n73\t**Root cause**: `n_points` was **0** for all fields after the first one\n74\t\n75\t### Failure Point Stack Trace\n76\t\n77\t```\n78\tdecode_message (line 309-310):\n79\t  n_grid = builder.grid.as_ref().map(|g| g.num_data_points as usize).unwrap_or(0)\n80\t  // ^ builder.grid was None for fields 1-195!\n81\t\n82\tdecode_section7 (line 1026):\n83\t  n_points = builder.grid.as_ref().map(|g| g.num_data_points as usize).unwrap_or(0)\n84\t  // ^ n_points = 0 passed to decode_drt3\n85\t\n86\tdecode_drt3 (line 1221):\n87\t  if packed.len() != n_points {\n88\t    return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: n_points, got: packed.len() });\n89\t  }\n90\t  // ^ packed.len() = 262792, n_points = 0 → error!\n91\t```\n92\t\n93\t## Buffer State at Failure\n94\t\n95\t### Lazy Decode (Successful)\n96\t```\n97\t--- Lazy Field 0 ---\n98\tGDT=30 PDT=0 DRT=3\n99\tGrid: template=30, num_data_points=262792, nx=614, ny=428\n100\tComplex extra: n_groups=8324, order_spatial_diff=2, extra_octet_count=2\n101\tSection 7 raw: 239901 bytes\n102\t```\n103\t\n104\t### Full Decode (Pre-Fix Failure)\n105\t```\n106\t--- Field 0 ---\n107\tGrid: num_data_points=262792, nx=614, ny=428 ✅\n108\tValues: 262792 points\n109\t\n110\t--- Field 1 ---\n111\tGrid: num_data_points=0, nx=0, ny=0 ❌\n112\tError: TooShort { needed: 262792, got: 0 }\n113\t```\n114\t\n115\tThe lazy decode succeeded because `LazyField` directly stores the grid from Section 3. The full decode failed because `FieldBuilder` was discarding the grid after each Section 7 flush.\n116\t\n117\t## Root Cause: Multi-Field Message Lifecycle\n118\t\n119\t### GRIB2 Message Structure\n120\t\n121\tThe NAM Lambert fixture is a **single GRIB2 message with 196 fields**:\n122\t\n123\t```\n124\tSection 0 (Indicator)           – once per message\n125\tSection 1 (Identification)      – once per message\n126\tSection 2 (Local Use)           – once per message (optional)\n127\tSection 3 (Grid Definition)     – once per message ← SHARED\n128\tSection 4 (Product Definition)  – once per field  (×196)\n129\tSection 5 (Data Representation) – once per field  (×196)\n130\tSection 6 (Bitmap)              – once per field  (×196)\n131\tSection 7 (Data)                – once per field  (×196)\n132\t\"7777\" (End marker)             – once per message\n133\t```\n134\t\n135\t**Critical detail**: Section 3 (Grid Definition) appears **once**, but all 196 fields reference it.\n136\t\n137\t### The Bug (Pre-Fix Code)\n138\t\n139\t**Before commit 3495514**, the `FieldBuilder` flush at the end of Section 7 decoding:\n140\t\n141\t```rust\n142\t// decode_message, lines 323-337 (PRE-FIX)\n143\tlet next_builder = FieldBuilder {\n144\t    center: builder.center,\n145\t    subcenter: builder.subcenter,\n146\t    ref_time: builder.ref_time,\n147\t    // ❌ Grid definition DISCARDED — defaults to None\n148\t    // grid: prev_grid,        // MISSING\n149\t    // gdt_template: prev_gdt_template,  // MISSING\n150\t    ..Default::default()\n151\t};\n152\t```\n153\t\n154\t**Impact**: After flushing field 0, fields 1-195 had:\n155\t- `builder.grid = None`\n156\t- `builder.gdt_template = None`\n157\t- At Section 7 decode: `n_grid = 0` (from `unwrap_or(0)`)\n158\t- Result: \"buffer too short\" because `packed.len() == 262792` but `n_points == 0`\n159\t\n160\t### The Fix (Commit 3495514)\n161\t\n162\t**Post-fix code**:\n163\t\n164\t```rust\n165\t// decode_message, lines 323-337 (POST-FIX)\n166\tlet prev_grid = builder.grid.clone();\n167\tlet prev_gdt_template = builder.gdt_template;\n168\tlet next_builder = FieldBuilder {\n169\t    center: builder.center,\n170\t    subcenter: builder.subcenter,\n171\t    ref_time: builder.ref_time,\n172\t    // ✅ Preserve grid definition for subsequent fields\n173\t    grid: prev_grid,\n174\t    gdt_template: prev_gdt_template,\n175\t    ..Default::default()\n176\t};\n177\t```\n178\t\n179\t**Impact**: All 196 fields now have access to the shared Section 3 grid definition:\n180\t- `builder.grid = Some(GridDefinition { num_data_points: 262792, ... })`\n181\t- `builder.gdt_template = Some(30)`\n182\t- Result: All fields decode successfully with `n_points = 262792`\n183\t\n184\t## Why This Only Manifested on Multi-Field Messages\n185\t\n186\tSingle-field GRIB2 messages worked fine because:\n187\t1. Section 3 parsed → `builder.grid` populated\n188\t2. Section 7 decode → `builder.grid` still present\n189\t3. \"_provenance\": \"string\",\n  \"fields\": [Field, ...]\n}\n```\n\n### Root Properties\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `fixture_id` | string | Yes | Unique identifier for the test fixture (e.g., `\"drt2_simple_3x3\"`) |\n| `_provenance` | string | Yes | Human-readable description of how this fixture was generated |\n| `fields` | array[Field] | Yes | Array of GRIB2 field objects (most fixtures contain exactly 1) |\n\n---\n\n## Field Object\n\nEach field represents a complete GRIB2 message with all its metadata sections.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"center\": number,\n  \"subcenter\": number,\n  \"parameter\": {\n    \"discipline\": number,\n    \"category\": number,\n    \"number\": number\n  },\n  \"forecast\": {\n \"scaled_value1\": number,\n    \"type2\": number,\n    \"scale_factor2\": number,\n    \"scaled_value2\": number\n  },\n  \"ensemble\": Ensemble | null,\n  \"grid\": {\n    \"template\": number,\n    \"num_data_points\": number,\n    \"nx\": number,\n    \"ny\": number,\n    \"lat_first\": number,\n    \"lon_first\": number,\n    \"lat_last\": number,\n    \"lon_last\": number,\n    \"di\": \"gdt_template\": number,\n  \"pdt_template\": number,\n  \"drt_template\": number,\n  \"packing\": {\n    \"reference_value\": number,\n    \"binary_scale_factor\": number,\n    \"decimal_scale_factor\": number,\n    \"bits_per_value\": number,\n    \"original_field_type\": number\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### Field Properties\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description Parameter discipline/category/number |\n| `forecast` | Forecast | Yes | Forecast time metadata |\n| `level` | Level | Yes | Vertical level descriptor |\n| `ensemble` | Ensemble\\|null | Yes | Ensemble // 1-12\n  \"day\": number,         // 1-31\n  \"hour\": number,        // 0-23\n  \"minute\": number,      // 0-59\n  \"second\": number,      // 0-59\n  \"significance\": number // 0=analysis, 1=start of forecast\n}\n```\n\n**Types:** All integers\n\n### Forecast\n\n```json\n{\n  \"reference_time\": ReferenceTime,\n  \"time_range_unit\": number,  // Indicator (1=hour, etc.)\n
